purpose: Current official-document compatibility hypotheses for installing Finalisma as an MCP server in independent agent hosts.
claim_boundary: Documentation proves that each listed host exposes an MCP client surface. It does not prove that Finalisma has completed an end-to-end pairing, reconnect, cancellation, and verified-handoff run in that host.

status_definitions.verified: A fresh end-to-end Finalisma host run is captured in this repository with version, configuration, transcript, and expected protocol assertions. (Per-host status.)
status_definitions.documented-unverified: Current official host documentation describes a compatible MCP transport, but this repository has no fresh end-to-end host run.
status_definitions.adapter-required: The host cannot consume Finalisma directly through its documented MCP surface and needs a maintained adapter.
status_definitions.unsupported: Current official evidence shows that the required connection path is unavailable.
status_definitions.tier-validated: A committed transcript proves the CONNECTION TIER works end to end (protocol, adapter library, or SDK) against a real coordinator, even if no specific host product is configured. See summary.tier_transcripts.

tier_transcripts.sdk: validated — SDK tier incl. N-agent rooms, docs/INTEROP_SDK_2026-08-05.md

hosts.name: OpenCode v2
hosts.configuration_surface: mcp.servers in OpenCode configuration (type local / type remote), or opencode mcp add
hosts.finalisma_path: Local server entry or remote Streamable HTTP entry
hosts.validation_detail: opencode 1.18.13 loaded finalisma as a type:local stdio MCP server and a headless agent run completed the full lifecycle: register x2, pairing create/preview/consent-join, task create/claim/verify/complete. Initial run exposed a JS-safe-integer fencing-token defect (secrets.randbits(63) truncated by the JS transport); fixed to randbits(51) and re-validated green. See docs/INTEROP_VALIDATION_2026-08-05.md for the config file path and transcript.
hosts.blocking_caveat: None observed for the stdio path. The v2 configuration schema differs from older unversioned documentation, so install instructions should stay version-pinned.
hosts.next_verification: Reconnect behaviour, cancellation, and a second independent host (Claude Code or Cursor) remain unverified.
